literal: Army, subjects, wealth, ministers, allies, fort - all six / he who possesses / among kings / is a lion.
translation: He who possesses all six—an army, citizens, wealth, ministers, allies, and a fort—is a lion among kings.
modern: படை, குடிமக்கள், செல்வம், அமைச்சர்கள், நண்பர்கள், அரண் ஆகிய ஆறு அங்கங்களையும் முழுமையாக உடையவன் அரசர்களுக்குள் சிங்கம் போன்றவன் ஆவான்.
explanation: This couplet lists the six essential pillars of a strong state: a military force, a loyal populace, economic resources, wise ministers, reliable allies, and fortified defenses. The word 'கூழ்' literally means food, but is used here in the broader sense of wealth or national resources. The word 'ஏறு' refers to a male animal, such as a majestic bull or lion, and is used metaphorically to denote a supreme leader; thus, a ruler who successfully commands all six of these elements stands out as a mighty chief among kings.
